findings.title: Web server software disclosed (with version)
findings.description: The server disclosed its software via the Server header: 'Python/3.11.9'.
findings.why_it_matters: Version numbers help attackers identify known vulnerabilities. Even without a version, the software name narrows the attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Remove the 'Server' response header (or disable the framework option that adds it) to reduce information disclosure.

findings.title: HTTPS not available
findings.description: Could not establish a TLS connection to 127.0.0.1:8003: [SSL: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER] wrong version number (_ssl.c:1006)
findings.why_it_matters: Without HTTPS, all traffic — including credentials — is transmitted in plaintext.
findings.recommendation: Enable TLS on the server and redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: Missing security header: X-Frame-Options
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: Without clickjacking protection an attacker can embed the page in a transparent iframe and trick users into unintended actions.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN if framing by same-origin pages is required).
